translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yesus be adikum num Got wane ilkádawin ko.

Yu kayak imi sawa abem bo mada Got ami yanol ufek ufek kidel kuyamokaba umi kit. Kata bo atin kik fitin umi dam bá. Kale bemi mit ata sun kuw itol makuw makuw uyo wane ilkádawin kukuw makuw be ki fasiki fasiki bom wanang kinim leiw fen bom maek Got mit tem tadiwo Got suksuklawumo kalsiw be ken atin kidela imudomu banim.
Kale wanang kinim imi Got suksukin uyo atin kidel ban keimin banim nam, ika ban keimin fatom so mak keiyamoma banim kei nadiwe alo makso wane ilkádawin uyo kudew tade modiw banim keidongino ka.
Kata wanang kinim imi sun kuw itol tadenbu tadenbu uyo ulum kanom wane ilkádawin iniman uyo kudew tademsiw, kale bo kukuyam naduno bidi ban keimin wanang kinimo, yakbu.
Be watawo kaleyo bá, iniman kau kimak so meme so imi kaim be ken ban keimin uyo atin takan keiyamu banimomu bá kayo ko.
Bemi mit ata Kadais ayo madák bakan nadane Got bakodaw,

content.text: “kaba, iniman kaim umi wane ilkákamin so fet dawkákamin so uyo mak kudulomi báyo, kalesaw. Kala kaleyo kaba nam dam uyo kidela kunamsaw kale naka wane ilukamokabi.

Kale kinim wanang imi iniman fu bi kudew tam wane ilkákamin bán dim kuti kalam win kufáka bom nadiwe ayo iniman wane ilkákamin tuw ban keimin sánuw kaí, kalanámaliw, kata kaba bako nadaw keno kalongin banim keiyábaw.

Kale naka bako, ‘Got kadák fenal! Naka tad kalam kanodalo.’ Nakbaw uyo kanodono kanami. Kale naka nalami uyo wanang kinim imi ban keimin luk dudu fikalono kali. Kale buk tem be nalam guton bakosu kayo, ‘Got kaba, kalakabi ka. Naka kalam aket kanoyo nakbaw uyo kanodokabi.’”

content: Akeisa.
Kale kamakikiw aka bako, “kaba, iniman kaim umi wane ilkákamin so fet dawkákamin so uyo mak kudulomi báyo, kalesaw.” Kalesa be sawa abem uyo bako kanamino, yakeisu, kata aka bu báyo kalesa ka.

Alo aka bako nadale, “Got kaba, kalak kábi ka. Naka kalam aket kanoyo nakbaw uyo kanodokabi.” Akeisa. Kale Got ayo dil wane ilkádawin uyo banima ku nadane Yesus ami alam alokso wane ilkádawin uta dil umi abin kuduse kala.

Kale be watawo kaleyo bá, Yesus Kadais ayo Got kanodalo, akeise uyo kanodane, wanang kinim adikum numi ban keimin gine imusa be alam dam tuw Got wane ilkádawin be alam bid makuw mose be ki, alam kamano so ulum kano sun bokaba.

Kale Yu Kayak im bowál adikum iyo ilimi wok uyo sun kuw faku bom nadiwo ufek ufek ulum makuw bu ki wane ilkádaw bom keimámsiw, kata wane ilkádawin be ken mak ban keimin umi fatom atin takan keiyamongin banim.
Kata Yesus Kadais aka alam dam uyo bid makuw fakadá num ban keimin umi laban wane ilumamse, be ulum kano sun sun bokabu. Kale aka kano
nadane tam Alaw Got teng iwkuko kal tein sada si, Got ayo alam wasi iyo imadew tad alam kitid akfak tem imtidokaba.
Kale Kadais alam dam makuw mo Got wane iludawse tuw wanang kinim abem kei imkanba, ita kidel kei imuse, kale be atin banimoma banim.
Kale Got Sinik Abem aka alasino bumi sung uyo bakoyam,

content.text: “naka yanol wanang kinim so abino kalokabuw ko. Kamok weng kalesa. Ade naka nalam sawa abem uyo kudew yak ilim aket tem teiyam nadine gebom tem goduyamokabi.”

content: Kalesa.
Ade alo aka bako,

content.text: “naka kinkino yakei nadino im ban keimin so kukuw mafak so uyo lukuwá kudáyam nadine atin makso fukan dádomi banim keidokabi.”

content: Kalesa.
Kale aka num ban keimin uyo lukuwá kadáyamase, kayo iniman kudew tad ban keimin takeik kanin uyo banimasu, kayo makso kanamoduw banim ka.
Ulum kano maek Got mit tem ki bum kala.
Kala kaleyo, nalam nikil fikal kiba, nuka nulum ban keimin fatom uyo banimu luk bala kei suduw, kayo nuka ken atud kuw fakadá Yesus fikalese dim tam Abin Atin Abem uyo unoduw ka.
Nuka alokso leiw Yesus Kadais sinik so dam tem yak Abin Atin Abem tem unoduw ka. Yesus ami dam be ilim kal dukum kufo tam Abin Atin Abem unemin umi abin kuduse uta ko.
Nulum bokal kayak dukum ata Got ami Yol am bo kin mo be kayo nuka ken tam Got atamokabuw,
kayo maek atin wok tuw ban bomin bo naduwe nuka aket kidel kuw fukanin so atin Got afan kalin so aket fatom keiyámin banim so umi dim maek Got mit tem tadum kala.
Kale nuka mimin dok diyámin sung wanang kinim madik bakayabuw uyo atin kitid kuw fakudum kala. Watawo kaleyo bá, nuka nulum kal Got aka alam weng takadá kanoyamokabino, yakeisa uyo afan kanoyamokaba.
Kale nuka ken leiw fen bom akanum aket kudawa kudawain kukuw so kukuw kidel fakuyámin so uyo kuw kitid modawa modawayum kala.

Kale Got wanang kinim gu numi tada tada bom dakodawa dakodawain kukuw uyo yak wanang kinim madik imi kanamongin banim itaw keimin bá, kata nikil nuka akanum daw kitid moda modain kukuw uyo kidela tamso tamso faku suduwo kala, kale kilim kal Yesus ami tademin am afung am uyo mew tadbu kala.

Kale nuka nulum kal kei Kadais ayo num ban keimin takan keiyama, nuka be afan kale suduw uyo alo aket fukan dá ban keimumo kaluw namti, atin alo wane ilkádawin maksono masi alo wane ilulawuw num ban keimin takan keiyamokaba bá kala.
Kale be ban keimin wane ilkádawin kukuw bo atin banim, kale nuka alo ban keimuw kaí, alam bede taktakin so Got ami keng as kainin so umi tad im mafak dádokabu atud ki fingán bom fenin ka.

Kale kinim mak Mosus ami Got sawa abem daudawsa uyo bo lukel bada kot kidimin kinim ayo fen dá afan dam atamokaba ayo ki kinim alewo alewbino kin wala atabiw namti, kot kidimin kinim ayo kinkino kalongin banim fikalako, yakansa.

Kim aket yak kinim Got ami Min ayo atin kun falali akongin banim keibe, be yaknodawokabiw. Aka kaek fen abino kalin umi kaim kanodawa kinim abem keise uyo utam nadane bo kaim abem báyo, kalba. Be aka Got ami min gelemin Sinik Abem ayo atafiba. Kayo aka atin Mosus sawa lukelin imi sok gei tabamin uyo akayam atin tamso sok gei tabamin mafak uyo ken kuduloma ka.
Kale nulum kal Got aka buk tem bako, “nata kuw kim kukuw mafak mafak kanamáliw yán uyo kuyamokabi.” Kalesa. Ade alo sawil bako nada, “Kamok ayo alam kinim wanang iyo taktaka imudokaba.” Kalesa.
Kaleyo Got Motabid atin dukum kitid soim ami imadew faku sok gei imudokaba uyo ki atin mafak seng ko.
Kiba finang dá utamin, kamakikiw Got weng tatun afan kalesidiw atan kabadák uyo kiba abin mafak teinámsiw be seng, kata kiba kitid tabe bo akamamsidiw.

Ade kinim wanang ika ididiya bom nadiwe mafak kuw keiyámsiw ade alo yak wanang kinim madik iyo kalam kin dim im mafak dákamsiwo, kibil yak wanang kinim madik iyo kilim kin dim im mafak dákabidiw, kiba aket budunin dauyam kinkino, yakbiw.

Ade alo kinim madik iyo sok gei imkan bidiw kinkino yak bom nadiwe kim ufek ufek adikum dakiyábiw uyo bo kinkino yakanámsiw, bo watawo kaleyo bá, kiba kilim kal keidomo kim ufek ufek atin kidelok seng sun bokabu uyo abid tikin kal bu kayo kala.
Kaleyano, kim atud fakadáyamin uyo kudáyamin bá, kala watawo kaleyo bá, kiba yanol ufek ufek yán kisol dukum kuw kukáyamokaba.
Kale kiba kidela dakbu beta ken Got alam kanamino, yakba uyo kidel kuw faku nadiw kilálokabiw, beta adikum ufek ufek alam weng boyamsa uyo kudulokabiw kala.
Kaleyo Got ami godin buk tem bako,

content.text: “kinim alam tadono kaleba, aka tadokaba ade aka alam tademin atan uyo akamam tow so keidoma banim.
Kale nalam wanang kinim kidel kuw tabesiw ika ilim afan kalin dim ken bokabiw. Kata kan ata ibik wakunamokaba kaí, naka aso kalfalawomi banim.”

content: Kalesa.
Kata nuka mul wakudaw kalo makalo keisuw wanang kinim bá, nuka nulum afan kalin dim kail bá takeikuyamsa wanang kinim make.
